title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
abstract: arXiv:2611.19078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. translated_title: 面向异构团队组合式多智能体强化学习的假设/保证契约
translated_abstract: 异构团队的多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题要求智能体协作完成团队任务，同时充分利用多样化的智能体能力。我们为异构多智能体系统引入了假设/保证契约（AGC-MAS），并提出了面向MARL的迭代异构分配方法（IHA-MARL）。AGC-MAS契约是一种组合式对象，它对构成整体团队任务的每个子任务所接收的假设条件以及所需提供的保证进行编码。我们将契约形式化为元组，用于规定子任务、自动机、超时与成功概率要求以及调度行为。该自动机跟踪智能体在其契约所对应子任务中的高层进展，并为跨契约的同步提供了自然的机制。这一抽象方法能够在异构的底层子任务实现之间实现稳健的交互，并允许异构智能体相互替换使用。
tldr: 本文提出假设/保证契约（AGC-MAS）与迭代异构分配（IHA-MARL）方法，通过将子任务的假设与保证编码为包含自动机的组合式契约元组，实现异构智能体团队的稳健协作、任务同步与智能体替换的组合式多智能体强化学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces assume/guarantee contracts (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment (IHA-MARL), encoding subtask assumptions and guarantees as compositional contract tuples with automata to enable robust collaboration, synchronization, and agent substitution in compositional MARL for heterogeneous teams.
